brook: +4 maximum health, rising to +6. Every fifth damaging weapon hit heals 1 (+2 at bond III).
cairn: +4 armour, rising to +6. Hits of 4 or more deal 1 less damage (3 or more at bond III).
cinder: Every fourth damaging weapon hit on the same foe deals +1 damage (+2 at bond III).
flint: +2 armour. Every fifth damaging weapon hit adds +2 damage (+3 at bond III) and slows its target for 1 second.
gale: 20% less run energy used; +2 accuracy from 3 tiles. Every fourth damaging weapon hit restores 4–6 run energy.
pyre: Switching between melee, ranged and magic damaging hits adds +1 damage (+2 at bond III), at most once per 6 seconds.
rill: +1 armour (+2 at bond II). Every fourth damaging weapon hit on the same foe restores 1 health (+2 at bond III).
zephyr: 15% less run energy used. At least 3 tiles away, ranged and magic gain +4 accuracy, rising to +6.
